context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export endpoint fully working. Fix verified: multi_cell(w=190, new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT') resolves fpdf2 v2.8.7 cursor drift. Email sent to student confirmed in logs. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_export_pdf.py

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: fpdf2 v2.8.7 changed behavior of multi_cell(w=0). Previously w=0 meant 'use remaining width and reset to left margin'. Now it doesn't reset x position, causing subsequent multi_cell calls to fail with 'Not enough horizontal space'.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed from multi_cell(w=0, ...) to multi_cell(w=190, ..., new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT') to explicitly set width and cursor position after each cell.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Backend returns 200 OK with valid PDF, email sent to student confirmed in logs.
